newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU seen valuing late-Nov French wheat at $145.55.
newsitem.headline: EU seen valuing late-Nov French wheat at $145.55.

text.p: A European Union award of 350,500 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 22.35 Ecus per tonne, reported by EU grain officials, values a tonne of late-November French wheat at $145.55 per tonne, Reuters calculates.
The figure, which should be regarded as an estimate only, is based on benchmark standard-quality French milling wheat at Rouen and may vary significantly for other EU origins and types.
The calculation uses the following assumptions gathered from market sources and Reuters data.
Implied fob price in dollars 145.55 dollars/tonne.
The same formula suggests an unsubsidised French fob price of $175.97 per tonne. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5146
